subject: Candidate handoff: Rubicon - next steps & hiring recommendation
messages:
From: tessa_morgan
To: jordan_blake, laura_bennett, monica_patel, maya_srinivasan
Cc: recruiter@rubiconai.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Rubicon candidate — morning: scorecards + proposed next steps

Hi team,

Ari Navarro finished onsite yesterday (back-end role, distributed systems). Thanks to everyone who interviewed. I collected individual notes and attached Ari's resume for reference. We need to converge on a hiring recommendation and surface any blocking concerns before end of day so we can share feedback with Rubicon and decide owner for an offer.

Action items:
- Please fill the scorecard (link and PDF attached) by 1pm PT.
- Add any significant red flags as a short reply so they are visible in-thread.
- If you recommend proceeding, reply with the suggested leveling (L4/L5) and any comp guidance.

Attachments: [Attachment: ari_navarro_resume.pdf (PDF, 220KB)], [Attachment: rubicon_interview_scorecard-template.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett
To: tessa_morgan, jordan_blake, monica_patel, maya_srinivasan
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rubicon candidate — morning: scorecards + proposed next steps

Thanks, Tessa — completed my scorecard (attached in the Greenhouse comment). Quick summary: strong systems design, excellent debugging walkthroughs, some gaps on infra monitoring experience but feels trainable. Recommend L4 with manager-level support. No blocking issues.

- Laura
Engineering Manager
From: jordan_blake
To: laura_bennett, monica_patel, tessa_morgan, maya_srinivasan
Date: 2026-11-20T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rubicon candidate — morning: scorecards + proposed next steps

All — friendly nudge: still waiting on scorecards from Monica and Maya. We need unanimous agreement to move to offer cadence. If you have concerns, put them here so Tessa can relay. If you're good, reply with 'approve: L4' or 'approve: L5' and a one-line rationale.

We should aim to decide by 3pm PT.

-Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
From: monica_patel
To: jordan_blake, laura_bennett, tessa_morgan, maya_srinivasan
Date: 2026-11-20T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Rubicon candidate — morning: scorecards + proposed next steps

Sorry for the delay — just submitted my scorecard. Short note: Ari's code exercise was solid but took a bit long to optimize; however, they demonstrated good trade-off reasoning. Recommend L4. No security concerns.

- Monica
Senior Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan
To: recruiter@rubiconai.com, jordan_blake, laura_bennett, monica_patel, maya_srinivasan
Date: 2026-11-20T16:38:00-08:00
Subject: Final: candidate consensus + suggested owner for offer

Hi Rebecca / Rubicon hiring team — quick update from Redwood: after debriefs and compiled scorecards (attached), we have consensus to move forward with Ari Navarro at level L4. No blocking feedback; reviewers noted monitoring depth as a development area but not disqualifying.

Proposed next steps:
- Rubicon to initiate reference check (we can coordinate).
- Redwood to receive the offer owner and target comp range — recommend starting at mid-L4 band.
- I will send official feedback and the compiled scorecards to your recruiting inbox after you confirm next steps.

Attachments: [Attachment: compiled_scorecards_20261120.pdf (PDF, 340KB)]

Internal note: Jordan, Laura, Monica — agree to delegate offer to Rebecca at Rubicon? Please confirm so I can send the compiled pack.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
